shortDescription: British insurer Legal & General LSE:LGEN reported smaller-than-expected third-quarter net outflows at its asset management arm on Monday, helped by strong momentum in its retail business.Here are some details:($1 = 0.7571 pounds)

children: reported smaller-than-expected third-quarter net outflows at its asset management arm on Monday, helped by strong momentum in its retail business.
The company's net outflows slowed to £3 billion ($3.96 billion) in the quarter, beating expectations of £4.5 billion of outflows, as per a company-compiled consensus
L&G said strong retail momentum seen in the first half continued into the third quarter, as annuity sales increased 25% year-on-year to £1.5 billion in the first nine months
Total managed-assets reached £1.2 trillion at the end of September, up 4% year-on-year, though down £12 billion in the quarter, primarily reflecting negative market movements
CEO António Simoes has been simplifying the sprawling 190-year-old financial group through job cuts and divestitures as part of efforts to reduce costs and improve performance
However, L&G's UK pension risk transfer volumes reached £3.6 billion in the quarter, missing estimates of £4.6 billion

title: British insurer L&G's third-quarter outflows slow, retail momentum holds strong
